messages:
emily: Quick thought — current deprecation routing makes it awkward for tenant teams to do a short pin to v1 during regressions. Could we add a per-route Pin/Unpin control in the console with an ephemeral TTL?
rahul: Do you mean a user-set TTL that automatically unpins after X minutes/hours? How do we surface billing/quotas for that pinned traffic? :thinking:
olivia: Yeah, TTL. Implementation-wise we can store metadata on the route override: {route_id, pinned_version: \"v1\", pinned_until: <ts>, actor}. Telemetry should tag tokens with route_pin:true and pinned_version so we can slice metrics.
ben: Backend caveat — routing precedence must still honor critical fallbacks. If we add a per-route override, we need clear rules: override > routing policy but < emergency system-level circuit-breaker. Also TTL changes must invalidate route caches instantly to avoid sticky sessions.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "route-pin-console" rolled to canary (eng-platform) — 3 hosts. Monitor errors.
sam: On quotas: if a tenant pins to v1 and that model is served from Dedicated vs Hosted, how do we account? We don't want surprise rate-limits or bill surprises.
emily: Proposal: pinned traffic should follow the tenant's configured capacity binding: if their account is on Dedicated and the route is attached to that pool, pinned requests consume reserved capacity; otherwise route through hosted and bill at hosted rates. Console should surface a short projection: "Pinned -> will consume Dedicated quota" or "Pinned -> billed as Hosted".
olivia: Add a tiny telemetry alert: if pinned rate > 5% of tenant's historical traffic in 10m window, auto-notify SE and flag in console. That helps catch accidental mass-pinning.
ben: Implementation note: route override can piggyback on existing routing metadata store, but we must add atomicity for simultaneous pin/unpin requests (optimistic locking). Also add audit log entry for every pin action.
emily: UX: show a compact badge on route list: "Pinned to v1 — ends in 2h (by adele)" with a 2-step unpin for admins. For non-admins show a request flow.
adele: +1 for 2-step unpin on high-traffic routes. Wording suggestion: "Temporarily pin to older model for urgent rollback — auto-expiry ensures safety." :white_check_mark:
rahul: One more telemetry ask: emit metric route_pin.duration and route_pin.count and a tag for pin_reason (manual|auto|rollback). Makes it easier to correlate with regressions.
olivia: Example header we can use for routing override API: 
```
X-Route-Pin: v1;ttl=3600;actor=adele@example.com
```
That also lets SDKs opt-in for testing flows.
sam: Sounds workable. Any security concerns about allowing SDKs to set that header? We should only honor header if request is from a service identity with pin permissions, otherwise ignore.
emily: Agreed — console actions create signed override tokens; raw header only accepted from internal-authenticated contexts.
adele: Okay — I'll mock console copy and wireframes. Who wants to own the telemetry infra changes?
olivia: I can take metrics/alerts. Ben can take routing-store changes. Emily will draft console UX and copy.
emily: Thanks — I'll create a GH issue and link design mocks. Returning to deploy-bot: canary health check now. :eyes:
